title: Retail USA Musashi sword ribbons

source.note: Actual SC01 initializer bodies at801681FC/80168430 override shared variants; raw USA bytes are authoritative.

ring.record_rule: Advance index, store midpoint whose outer-inner direction is normalized to4096 then divided by descriptor divisor; advance again and store current pair; clamp count to15.
ring.fade_rule: Subtract16 from brightness. Stop when<16; otherwise reduce segment count by1 if count>=2 and brightness>>4<count.

colors.note: Color is per vertex and age; Fusion alternate selection is save flag0x81, not attack number or equipment.

states: initialize descriptor and clear previous same-weapon effect
decrement duration and record or enter fade
fade and draw until no quads
lifecycle.record_ticks_semantics: Duration is decremented before recording; an uninterrupted descriptor records duration-1 updates after seeding.
lifecycle.activation: Effect actor initialization/wait states; separate from contact opcode0x14.
lifecycle.fusion_four_continuations: Keep existing actor through rise/apex/drop/land; do not restart for each animation stream.
lifecycle.rotation_continuation: Ordinary Rotation uses descriptor8 through paused windup, dynamic held-pose spin and rotation_end; do not restart at the tail. Mighty Strike counter uses descriptor7.

endpoints.format: signed byte xyz pair in 16-byte pose header
endpoints.gltf_position_conversion: (x,-y,-z)*0.01, same double conversion used by source_transform in recovered body GLB
endpoints.world_transform: Apply recovered model rotation and translation; actor world points remain independent of later movement.
endpoints.sampling: Use last frame whose tick<=clip time*30; STEP poses hold through next frame tick. Externally clocked continuation poses hold until their native state advances.
endpoints.midpoint: Average both endpoints with previous pair using arithmetic shift>>1. Normalize outer-minus-inner to4096, divide each axis by original descriptor divisor with truncation towardzero, then add midpoint inner.

raw_assets.purpose: Two original byte-pair delay/duration tables and length-divisor tables
Effect queue type4 and5 select 80166618 and80166654
Four-state Fusion and Lumina dispatch tables
Untextured POLY_G4; RGB byte ordering and submission flags
0x40000000 enables semitransparency, flag bits28..29 select ABR

raw_assets.format: repeated little-endian u32 VRAM address + 16 raw pose-header bytes

limitations: Source quad topology/colors/tables and signed pose endpoints are recovered. Host rasterization, PS1 color quantization/dithering and GTE integer precision require separate parity validation.
Absolute first effect tick depends on original actor-queue update order; manifest exposes wait/init/record phases instead of claiming contact-frame alignment.
The semantic in-game name of save flag0x81 is not established here; do not infer it from full equipment.
This manifest covers sword ribbons, including ordinary Rotation and Mighty Strike. Collision/contact flashes and the Mighty Strike vortex have independent source paths.
